letters.title: My Dearest Best Friend ❤️
body: There are a million words in the world, but none feel big enough to hold what you mean to me. How lucky am I to have found someone who feels like home, like safety, like the warmest light on the darkest days...

letters.title: Dear Bestie 🤍
body: Sometimes I wish you could see yourself the way I see you. Maybe then you would finally understand how comforting your presence feels and how easily you make life feel a little softer for the people who truly care about you...
You already are enough, exactly as you are. ❤️

letters.title: Heyy Babe 🥳
body: The day we met at school till today, you have only become more special to me. The fun we had in school and the fun we have now is still the same level of craziness...
